share_60plus.table_field: cc-est2025-agesex: AGE6064 + AGE6569 + AGE7074 + AGE7579 + AGE8084 + AGE85PLUS / POPESTIMATE

share_65_hh_75k.table_field: B19037 age-of-householder x income; sum of 65+ bands with income >= 75,000 / 65+ total

non_earned_income_per_capita.table_field: CAINC4 line 46 (dividends, interest, and rent) / total population

home_equity_65.table_field: B25027 (65+ owner units without mortgage / all 65+ owner units) x B25077 (median home value)

spouse_share_65plus.table_field: B09021_024 (65+ living with spouse or spouse of householder) / B09021_022 (65+ total in households)

mortgage_share_65_owners.table_field: B25027: 65+ with mortgage / (65+ with + without mortgage)

ssa_beneficiary_share_65plus.table_field: SSA OASDI Table 4: beneficiaries aged 65 or older (men + women) / POPEST population aged 65+

internet_65plus.table_field: B28005 age x internet subscription; (B28005_016 dial-up alone + B28005_017 broadband) for 65+ / B28005_014 (65+ total)

chronic_burden_composite.table_field: PLACES crude prevalence: CHD, DIABETES, BPHIGH, CANCER, COPD; mean of per-measure z-scores across counties

risk_behaviour_composite.table_field: PLACES crude prevalence: OBESITY, CSMOKING, LPA (no leisure-time activity); mean of per-measure z-scores across counties

expected_ownership_65.table_field: B19037 65+ income distribution x priors.limra_barometer_2026 ownership curve (household-level anchors: under $50k 0.29, $150k+ 0.64)

area_health_context.table_field: PLACES MHLTH (poor mental health) + PHLTH (poor physical health) crude prevalence, mean, as a fraction
